description: Registry for RedEngine's curated, procedural core asset packs. Pack files contain prefab definitions; this file contains library-level discovery metadata.

policy.foundation: Keep the core small and broadly reusable. Specialized assets begin in a game's local prefab library.
policy.promotion: Promote a local asset only after reuse in more than one context, with a clear name, structured metadata, parameters, and a rendered review sheet.
policy.compatibility: Names are stable API identifiers. Prefer a new variant and deprecate the old identifier instead of silently changing its meaning.

packs.description: Engine-native objects that need custom collision or gameplay behavior
Reusable food, drink, and table-setting pieces
Kitchen fixtures, appliances, cookware, and service items
General-purpose seating, tables, storage, and residential furniture
Classroom, library, cafeteria, and gym vocabulary
Retail fixtures, stockroom equipment, and checkout vocabulary
General decoration, plants, signs, and small set-dressing
Visible lamp fixtures; scene lights remain separate
Street, yard, park, and exterior set pieces
